the FilmArray GI Panel is a very useful tool to characterize the microbiology of acute diarrhea and that it is important to consider the possibility of polimicrobial infection in patients with diarrhea.
multiplex panels are an important tool for the characterization of acute gastroenteritis and its epidemiology.
the use of a multiplex PCR panel in the diagnosis of acute diarrhea in adults in the emergency room setting has allowed us to identify a high number of etiologic microorganisms.

the clinical presentation of patients with acute diarrhea is not always related to the etiology and the clinical approach should be based on clinical suspicion rather than on laboratory results.
the FilmArray GI Panel can help to identify the microorganism responsible for the diarrhea and therefore guide the appropriate antibiotic therapy.
